An '''infant''' [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|girl]] born into [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]], one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Great Houses]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], was switched with an [[Unidentified Thul child|infant]] from [[House of Thul|House Thul]] as part of a Thul plot to attain power. The Thul infant was raised as an Organa, and House Thul supported the girl as a potential bride for the [[Unidentified crown prince|crown prince]] before a [[Unidentified Jedi (Thul scandal)|young Jedi]] exposed the deception.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Organa infant was mentioned in the Codex entry for House Thul in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
